_meta.description: Default img2img workflow — SDXL base with a fixed VAE + sampler chain. Operator overrides by dropping their own img2img.json into CMB_EXTRA_WORKFLOWS_DIR. Placeholder tokens (<<PROMPT>>, <<SOURCE_IMAGE_NAME>>, <<DENOISE>>, <<STEPS>>, <<SEED>>) are substituted at queue time by the bridge handler.
_meta.model_assumption: SDXL base. Operators on SD 1.5 / Flux / Pony / SD3 should drop a workflow JSON exported from their ComfyUI graph with the right model node.
_meta.outputs: Single image emitted by node 9 (SaveImage). The bridge reads it from history.outputs.9.images.

12._aa_passthrough_note: Pass-through wrapper so the KSampler's latent_image reference is stable across VAEEncode + (future) noise-add nodes; current workflow could plug KSampler.latent_image directly into [11, 0], but the wrapper makes it cheap to add a noise-injection step without re-wiring every reference.
